speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any specific patterns to the rash, such as it appearing on the sides of your fingers or under your nails?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Poison Ivy/Urushiol Contact Dermatitis with possible concurrent neuropathy or occupational exposure.

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Tests (LFTs), and Parathyroid Hormone (PTH).
REQUEST IMAGES: Skin biopsy of the rash and nerve conduction study of the hands.
